releaseNotes: v1.21.0: calls that survive network switches, and honest online status. Switching between Wi-Fi and mobile data during a call — even on both phones at once — now reconnects by design instead of by luck, and call signals are never lost while your connection is re-establishing. The green online dot now means exactly one thing: the person is actually in the app. Receiving a message in the background no longer shows you as online.
